title: Quran Study 57: Sura 2, Scripture Distortion, Hearsay, and the Cessation of Visible Miracles (1982-11-05)
source_file: data/sources/playlists/audio-transcripts/57 - Quran Study 05 Nov 1982 By Dr Rashad Khalifa.csv
document_summary: A continuation of the early Sura 2 study, centered on Quran 2:76–87. Participants discuss concealed information, scripture through hearsay and conjecture, people writing religious material and calling it divine, claims that Hell lasts only a few days, and the contrast between people surrounded by sin and those who believe and work righteousness. Dean Mahmoud and Rashad debate translation and grammar, then discuss demands for a messenger whose offering is consumed by fire, the killing of prophets, the Quran revealing concealed Israelite history, the cow narrative, resurrection of a murder victim, and Quran 17's statement that earlier visible miracles were stopped because they did not produce belief.

related_duplicate_sources.note: The Sura 2 study supplies textual examples of hearsay and distortion.

content_guidance.rule: Separate Quranic verses from historical examples

sections.title: The cow, resurrection of the murder victim, and why visible miracles were stopped
sections.summary: The cow narrative is revisited. A part of the sacrificed cow is used to revive a murder victim and identify the killer. Rashad says these were the days of visible miracles but cites Sura 17 for God's decision to stop sending them because even the sea crossing, manna, quail, and water from rocks did not produce lasting belief.
